entrants.description: Anonymous 'Best Tipster' from manual snapshot 2026-09-19: annual profit 263, strike rate 59%. Displayed stats are OLBG self-reported (10-point stake basis) and unverified.
entrants.name: OLBG best tipster (Man City v Sunderland)

entrants.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite (highest implied probability). Baseline reference, not a claimed edge.
entrants.name: Market favourite (baseline)

entrants.description: Always backs the margin-removed least-favoured team outcome (min of home/away implied probabilities; draw excluded). Tests the favourite-longshot bias on the pilot sample.
entrants.name: Market longshot probe (baseline)

entrants.description: Elo ratings (K=40, home adv 60); backs the model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed market >= 3%. No edge -> no bet.
entrants.name: Elo value edge

entrants.description: Same Elo model as elo-edge-v1 (K=40, home adv 60, shared rating history) but ratings relax toward 1500 with a pre-registered 365-day half-life; backs the 3-way model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed market >= 3%. Control for elo-edge-v1.
entrants.name: Elo value edge (recency decay)

entrants.description: Goal model with the Dixon-Coles tau low-score correction (pre-registered rho=-0.10, not fitted; negative cells reject the bet), same released-data league rates and shrunk team multipliers as the totals desk; backs the model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed 1X2 market >= 3%.
entrants.name: Dixon-Coles 1X2 value

entrants.description: Elo-based: back the 2-way leader when p_draw < 0.30 and max(p_home,p_away) >= 0.55; a draw loses (DNB rule).
entrants.name: Draw-No-Bet decisive

entrants.description: Draw mispricing probe: back DRAW when the Elo 3-way model's draw probability exceeds the margin-removed market draw probability by >= 3%. Research prior, not fitted.
entrants.name: Draw value probe

entrants.description: Home bias probe: back HOME only when the Elo model's home probability exceeds the margin-removed market price by >= 5% (deliberately selective). Research prior, not fitted.
entrants.name: Home-advantage value probe

entrants.description: Back the better recent-form side (mean points per match over last 3 released matches) when the gap >= 1.0 pts/match and the stored price >= 1.80. Tipster-style rule, fully auditable, no fitted parameters.
entrants.name: Form + price value

entrants.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (Maher/Dixon-Coles family; league rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches only, prior weight 6 matches) vs the margin-removed market over/under 2.5 price; bets the side with a >= 3% edge. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
entrants.name: Poisson totals value (O/U 2.5)

entrants.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the over/under 2.5 goals market. Baseline reference for the totals family, not a claimed edge.
entrants.name: Market totals favourite (O/U 2.5 baseline)

entrants.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (same priors as the totals desk) evaluated on the priced AH line (quarter lines split half/half); bets the side whose model EV beats the margin-removed market EV by >= 3% per unit staked, and only when the model EV itself is positive. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
entrants.name: Poisson Asian-handicap value

entrants.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the priced Asian handicap. Baseline reference for the AH family, not a claimed edge.
entrants.name: Market AH favourite (baseline)

entrants.description: 2-way Elo incl. OT/SO (K=32, home adv 35 Elo pts, research priors); backs the model favourite when win prob >= 55%. Prediction-only: DEL has no permissioned odds path in this build, so graded on accuracy, not PnL.
entrants.name: Hockey Elo favourite (no-market pilot)

entrants.description: Always predicts HOME. Flat 0.5/0.5 prior (uninformative by design: Brier stays 0.5; the hit rate is the reference point). Baseline for the hockey accuracy desks — prediction-only, never PnL.
entrants.name: Home-ice naive baseline (hockey)

entrants.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (league rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches only, prior weight 6); states the regulation-time 3-way view for every match (no selectivity - comparable to the always-home baseline). Generic prior 3.1/2.9 until >= 10 released matches, then released-data rates. Pre-registered, not fitted. Prediction-only: no permissioned DEL odds path - graded on regulation-time accuracy/Brier, never PnL.
entrants.name: Poisson regulation 3-way (hockey)

entrants.description: Always predicts HOME in regulation time. Flat 0.5/0/0.5 prior (uninformative by design: Brier against the 3-way actual is uninformative; the hit rate is the reference point). Baseline for the regulation 3-way desks - prediction-only, never PnL.
entrants.name: Regulation home naive baseline (hockey)

entrants.description: 2-way Elo on the OT/SO-aware final with the update scaled by the goal margin (K=32 x g, home adv 35 Elo pts; research priors, not fitted); backs the model favourite when win prob >= 55%. Control for hockey-elo-v1 - prediction-only (no permissioned odds path), graded on accuracy/Brier, never PnL.
entrants.name: Hockey Elo margin-of-victory (no-market pilot)

entrants.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (Maher/Dixon-Coles lineage) on the DEL final score: league rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches only (prior weight 6); generic prior 3.1/2.9 until >= 10 released matches. States the more likely side of the 5.5 line for EVERY match (no selectivity - comparable to its always-over baseline). Pre-registered, not fitted. Prediction-only: no permissioned DEL odds path - accuracy/Brier, never PnL.
entrants.name: Poisson total goals O/U 5.5 (hockey)

leaderboard.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (same priors as the totals desk) evaluated on the priced AH line (quarter lines split half/half); bets the side whose model EV beats the margin-removed market EV by >= 3% per unit staked, and only when the model EV itself is positive. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Poisson Asian-handicap value

leaderboard.description: Goal model with the Dixon-Coles tau low-score correction (pre-registered rho=-0.10, not fitted; negative cells reject the bet), same released-data league rates and shrunk team multipliers as the totals desk; backs the model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed 1X2 market >= 3%.
leaderboard.name: Dixon-Coles 1X2 value

leaderboard.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (Maher/Dixon-Coles family; league rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches only, prior weight 6 matches) vs the margin-removed market over/under 2.5 price; bets the side with a >= 3% edge. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Poisson totals value (O/U 2.5)

leaderboard.description: Back the better recent-form side (mean points per match over last 3 released matches) when the gap >= 1.0 pts/match and the stored price >= 1.80. Tipster-style rule, fully auditable, no fitted parameters.
leaderboard.name: Form + price value

leaderboard.description: Draw mispricing probe: back DRAW when the Elo 3-way model's draw probability exceeds the margin-removed market draw probability by >= 3%. Research prior, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Draw value probe

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the priced Asian handicap. Baseline reference for the AH family, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market AH favourite (baseline)

leaderboard.description: Elo ratings (K=40, home adv 60); backs the model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed market >= 3%. No edge -> no bet.
leaderboard.name: Elo value edge

leaderboard.description: Same Elo model as elo-edge-v1 (K=40, home adv 60, shared rating history) but ratings relax toward 1500 with a pre-registered 365-day half-life; backs the 3-way model-argmax when edge over the margin-removed market >= 3%. Control for elo-edge-v1.
leaderboard.name: Elo value edge (recency decay)

leaderboard.description: Home bias probe: back HOME only when the Elo model's home probability exceeds the margin-removed market price by >= 5% (deliberately selective). Research prior, not fitted.
leaderboard.name: Home-advantage value probe

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the over/under 2.5 goals market. Baseline reference for the totals family, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market totals favourite (O/U 2.5 baseline)

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite (highest implied probability). Baseline reference, not a claimed edge.
leaderboard.name: Market favourite (baseline)

leaderboard.description: Elo-based: back the 2-way leader when p_draw < 0.30 and max(p_home,p_away) >= 0.55; a draw loses (DNB rule).
leaderboard.name: Draw-No-Bet decisive

leaderboard.description: Always backs the margin-removed least-favoured team outcome (min of home/away implied probabilities; draw excluded). Tests the favourite-longshot bias on the pilot sample.
leaderboard.name: Market longshot probe (baseline)

bl1_warmup.note: Forward-desk rating history only (same Bundesliga clubs as bl1/2026). NOT part of the frozen 27-match PnL pilot, which stays pinned to matchdays 1/10/20.

hockey.note: Single-source pilot (OpenLigaDB, ODbL-1.0): identity stays 'probable' - no independent DEL cross-check exists in this repo. No permissioned odds path - predictions only, graded on accuracy/Brier; PnL unavailable (not zero). The full 2024/25 season is ingested, so the prediction desks grade on the whole season.

hypotheses.data: Whole committed 2024/25 bl1 season (306 finished results)
hypotheses.description: Always predicts the home side with a flat 0.50/0.25/0.25 prior. Reference point for the full-season football accuracy desks: the Elo desk must beat this on the same matches or its hit rate is not information.
hypotheses.name: Always-home season baseline

hypotheses.data: Whole committed 2024/25 bl1 season (306 finished results)
hypotheses.description: Same independent-Poisson construction as the pilot totals desk but with no price input: it states the more likely side of the 2.5 line for EVERY match, so it is comparable match-for-match with the always-over baseline over a full season.
hypotheses.name: Poisson totals season desk

hypotheses.description: Always predicts OVER 2.5 with a flat 0.5/0.5 prior (Brier 0.5 by construction). The share of over-2.5 matches in the pool is the bar the model must clear.
hypotheses.name: Always-over 2.5 season baseline

hypotheses.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite. Reference baseline: the market's own answer.
hypotheses.name: Market favourite (baseline)

hypotheses.description: Always backs the least-favoured team outcome; measures the favourite-longshot bias on the pilot.
hypotheses.name: Market longshot (baseline probe)

hypotheses.description: Elo 3-way model vs margin-removed market; bets the model argmax only with a >=3-point edge.
hypotheses.name: Elo rating + price discipline

hypotheses.description: Backs the 2-way Elo leader in decisive-looking games; a draw loses (DNB behaviour on 3-way odds).
hypotheses.name: Draw-No-Bet decisive form

hypotheses.description: Backs DRAW when the model's draw probability exceeds the fair market draw probability by >=3 points (retail under-buying of draws).
hypotheses.name: Draw mispricing probe

hypotheses.description: Backs HOME only on a >=5-point model edge over the fair price - tests whether the market under- or over-prices home advantage.
hypotheses.name: Home-advantage value probe

hypotheses.description: Classic tipster rule made auditable: back the better recent-form side (last <=3 released matches, >=1.0 pts/match gap) only at price >=1.80.
hypotheses.name: Form + price floor

hypotheses.data: OpenLigaDB current-season captures (ODbL) - no permissioned odds path for the current season
hypotheses.description: No-market 3-way Elo argmax with a 45% selectivity floor; frozen pre-start predictions for upcoming Bundesliga fixtures.
hypotheses.name: Football Elo favourite (forward desk)
hypotheses.test: Forward ledger - accuracy/Brier as results arrive

hypotheses.data: Same verified pilot file - its over/under 2.5 columns (B365/Avg/Max/BFE), same collection window
hypotheses.description: Independent-Poisson goal model (Maher 1982 / Dixon-Coles 1997 family): league rates + shrunk attack/defence multipliers from released matches only; bets over/under 2.5 with a >=3-point edge over the margin-removed market. Priors pre-registered, not fitted.
hypotheses.name: Poisson goal totals (O/U 2.5)

hypotheses.description: Always backs the market's more-likely side of over/under 2.5. Baseline for the totals family.
hypotheses.name: Market totals favourite (O/U baseline)

hypotheses.data: Same verified pilot file - its Asian-handicap columns (AHh line + AvgAHH/AHA prices; the B365/Max/BFE columns are stored too), same collection window. Column semantics verified against the source's notes.txt 2026-09-22: 'AHh = Market size of handicap (home team)'.
hypotheses.description: The totals desk's independent-Poisson goal model evaluated on the priced handicap line: full P(win)/P(push)/P(lose) margin distribution, quarter lines split half/half exactly as they settle. Bets the side whose model EV beats the de-margined market EV by >=3% per unit staked, only with positive model EV. Pre-registered priors, not fitted.
hypotheses.name: Poisson Asian-handicap value
hypotheses.test: Walk-forward Asian handicap (quarter-line split, integer-line push)

hypotheses.description: Always backs the margin-removed market favourite side of the priced Asian handicap. Baseline for the AH family, not a claimed edge.
hypotheses.name: Market AH favourite (baseline)

hypotheses.data: Verified pilot fixtures/results - same odds columns
hypotheses.description: The independent-Poisson model mis-estimates low-score dependencies (0-0, 1-0, 0-1, 1-1); Dixon-Coles add a tau correction. Implemented as a 1X2 value desk with a pre-registered rho=-0.10 prior (not fitted); negative score cells reject the bet outright. Same verified pilot fixtures and released-data construction as the totals desk; enters the Holm PnL family.
hypotheses.name: Dixon-Coles low-score correction

hypotheses.description: The frozen elo-edge-v1 desk weights every past match forever once it has moved a rating. Implemented as a control desk sharing the SAME rating history (elo_update) but reading ratings relaxed toward 1500 with a pre-registered 365-day half-life (stated before grading, never tuned on pilot outcomes). Same 3-way mapping and edge rule; enters the Holm PnL family.
hypotheses.name: Elo recency decay

hypotheses.description: Derived yes/no market from the goal model; requires BTTS prices, which the pilot file does not carry (no B365>BTTS-style columns exist in football-data exports) - a priced BTTS source is the gate, not the model.
hypotheses.name: Both teams to score (BTTS)

hypotheses.data: OpenLigaDB DEL pilot fixtures/results (ODbL) - no permissioned odds
hypotheses.description: 2-way Elo (final incl. OT/shootout) as a no-price baseline; graded on accuracy/Brier because no permissioned DEL odds path exists.
hypotheses.name: Hockey Elo favourite (no-market)

hypotheses.description: Same 2-way Elo model issuing frozen pre-start predictions for upcoming DEL fixtures once the current-season capture lands.

method.licence: 'open_licence_verified' is only ever set when the source already appears in northstar/policy.py (the tested licensing registry) with a collection mode that permits it. Everything else is 'not_reviewed' and stays behind a licence gate - robots.txt is not a licence.
method.links: links with link_verified=true returned the expected page content when fetched on 2026-09-22. Unverified deep links are marked false and point at the domain root that was actually fetched.
method.robots: robots.txt fetched over HTTPS through the agent's read-only fetch tool on 2026-09-22; the quoted text is verbatim from that fetch. A 404 (no robots file served) is recorded as 'no_robots_file' and is NOT permission. Line endings are normalised to LF when the quote is rendered (the CR/LF characters are the source's own line endings; the text is otherwise verbatim).
method.strategy_designs: design-stage entries are pre-registered hypotheses with no graded result; an entry may only be marked graded/forward-live if it names a strategy id that exists in northstar/strategies/REGISTRY.py and is unit-tested.
